Dear Parents: 
Fall Sports are in full swing but we need to also focus on the next sports season which is 
basketball. We are excited to announce that there will be new opportunities for players looking to 
play more advanced basketball in addition to playing in our normal YMCA recreation league. 
EFTA_R1_00695254 
EFTA02094438
--- PAGE 2 ---
The details are as follows: 
• 
We are currently planning two teams of approximately 10 players. This may change 
subject to participation. 
• 
Teams will be entered in the winter league of the Brewster Sports Center 
(www.brewstersportscenter.com ) about 30 minutes from New Canaan. They offer a 
competitive league in a well-run sports facility. 
• 
The season will begin in mid-to- late November and last until late March. We will do 
our best to avoid conflicts with the vacation and holiday schedule of New Canaan Public 
Schools. 
• 
Games and most practices will be played at various times on Saturdays and Sundays and 
we will schedule away from conflicts with the YMCA 4th grade league. We will look to 
play two games in consecutive time slots when available to minimize travel time. 
• 
Participation in the YMCA league will be a requirement to play this additional 
basketball. 
• 
The season will consist of 12 regular season games (plus playoffs) at Brewster plus
